standard_prerequisites.name: Right adjoints are left exact and exactness criteria for functors
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Categories, Section categories-section-exact-functor (tag 0034) and Section categories-section-adjoint (tag 0036)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the left exactness of f_* and the framework for reducing exactness to preservation of surjections.

core_obligations: Record that f_* on abelian sheaves, being a right adjoint, is already left exact, so it remains to prove right exactness, i.e. preservation of surjections (proof lines 1723-1734).

Show that each of the four listed hypotheses suffices for that preservation: surjections of sheaves of sets pull back to surjections of abelian sheaves, and commutation with coequalizers or with pushouts yields the required preservation of cokernels (proof lines 1735-1741).
Conclude that f_* : Ab(C) -> Ab(D) is exact, completing the proof up to line 1741.
proof_roadmap: Reduce each hypothesis to preservation of surjections.
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives four alternative hypotheses on a morphism of topoi - preservation of surjections of sheaves of sets or of abelian sheaves, commutation with coequalizers, or with pushouts - each of which forces the pushforward of abelian sheaves to be exact. Since f_* is a right adjoint, it is already left exact, so only the preservation of surjections has to be checked; the proof shows that each of the four hypotheses implies the corresponding statement about surjections or coequalizers needed to conclude right exactness, and then assembles the conclusion (proof lines 1723-1741). H2: the reduction of the four hypotheses to the single right-exactness statement is the substance.
